fixed.system: linear H4 adjacent1.00Angstrom STO-3G 8 system qubits; same saved state only as provenance, no state computation
fixed.df: tol-only1e-8 rank10; PR prefix1 plus one-body

selection: Pauli PF and DF PF singleton; Pauli PR and DF PR saved trajectory_index0. No cost-min/max or replacement trajectory. No RNG, no seed replay.
reuse_policy: Reuse all four saved full QPY byte-for-byte. No renaming/counter replay, additional full H4 build, alternate input, seed or sampling. The five isolation/empty builds require the next explicit execution approval.

ablation.policy: Delete only designated high-level groups before original control/compile; phases have disjoint owners; full emitter is never rebuilt by multiplying separately aggregated R/E.
ablation.retained: All forward and reverse retained blocks across all q steps plus constant, extracted identity and deterministic diagonal primitive phases. Remove all events. Do not merge boundaries or commuting terms manually.
ablation.event: Only the stored q groups of r events with order/negative-product/identity-rotation phases. No constant/extracted identity/deterministic primitive phase. Keep each occurrence's closing basis and phase before next occurrence; do not expand reuse across deleted gaps.
ablation.full: Original full operation and float accumulation order, including per-step phase placement and raw concatenation. Audit scalar_phase.angle is a summary, never emit that as a replacement lumped phase.
ablation.empty: QuantumCircuit(9,1) ancilla8 H,H,measurement. No controlled identity body, system/ancilla phase, state preparation, or compiler-visible tags.
ablation.phase_semantics: A system-global phase of the controlled evolution is ancilla-relative. It is not discardable. Do not alter floating summation/mod2pi order of the original full circuit. Isolation changes unitary; no new valid simulation or accuracy claim.

comparisons.sign: Keep signed integers, including negative increments/interactions. No clipping, fitting or additive allocation.
comparisons.depth: Report each depth; no additive depth budget or claimed causal depth contribution.
comparisons.H1: Compare isolated retained prices/increments across Pauli/DF at index0 and their context dependence. Does not identify effect of Z/ZZ retention alone or a unique dominant share.
comparisons.H2: Compare whole stored event-stream prices and tags at index0. No event-mean or component frequency aggregation; laws/angles differ and comparison is not matched.
comparisons.H3: Locate basis tags in retained and event and report actual source counters; compiled cost attributable specifically to basis remains unidentified.
comparisons.H4: Exact nonzero interaction demonstrates nonadditivity for the selected case; report magnitude and signs, no invented significance threshold, no unique boundary/compiler causal split.
comparisons.H5: Generic-control source and histogram expansion motivate D2 if unresolved. D1 alone cannot estimate equivalent-central-control counterfactual cost.
comparisons.claim_limit: Four selected representatives, no revised means, statistical confidence, population guarantee, certificate or general Pauli/DF superiority. Old PF/PR costs remain unchanged.

measured: RZ/CX depth if existing function supplies them
DF returned application/basis-switch/reuse counters per occurrence
metrics.before_control: Pauli source body exists before wrapper. DF virtual source histogram and pre-control central tags are collected during same schedule emission, not another whole H4 counterfactual circuit. Mark native central-control path and unavailable global after-control ratio as not directly comparable.
metrics.tags: Sidecar interval/range/group IDs only; no barriers, labels, gate names or metadata edits that change compiler input. Nested axes: role=retained/event/scalar/wrapper; kind=basis/Pauli/diagonal/control; do not double count nested categories or force assign every final RZ.
metrics.missing: Unavailable optional metric is null with reason; required RZ/CX/depth/program/hash and full reproduction gate cannot be silently skipped.

reproduction_gate.A: Retain exact historical match/fail independently. Three PASS and Pauli-PR FAIL remain immutable historical evidence.
reproduction_gate.B: Proposed SOURCE_SEMANTIC_CORRESPONDENCE criterion: each of twelve correspondence.json links, exact saved operands, meaningful schedule/phase/control and pinned runtime. Requires explicit user adoption before execution; current status CANDIDATE.
reproduction_gate.metadata: No blanket name removal, no normalized-hash substitute. Names of primitive/opaque gates or unresolved meaningful definition/control/phase changes are STOP. Generic composite names can be metadata only with SOURCE/recursive-body justification. Compiler sensitivity not presumed absent.
reproduction_gate.missing_preimage: Historical-only unknown payload/name is retained as UNKNOWN. It may be tolerated only under explicitly adopted SOURCE criterion, never claimed recovered. An unknown scientifically important SOURCE edge is STOP.
reproduction_gate.current_QPY_integrity: Recomputed actual current recursive fingerprint must match saved D1 fingerprint, not force Pauli-PR to old hash. This is self-integrity only, not scientific correspondence to old. Any discrepancy is STOP, no silent reserialization/rebuild.

execution_order.A: After explicit criterion and finite execution approval, bind new immutable controller SOURCE, used code/input/QPY/runtime and fresh one-shot grant in new namespace. Read four existing full QPY; record A and B separately; all four need (A or adopted B), with no Class1/meaningful Class3 discrepancy and fixed runtime/compiler/wrapper. Otherwise STOP before any cost compile.
execution_order.B: Only after Stage A and explicit execution approval. Compile full4 once each in existing fixed order; reserve each cost call before launch. Compare RZ exactly to old prices. First mismatch/error STOP; do not compile remaining targets, retry or refund.
execution_order.C: Only after all four full correspondence gates and four exact price gates PASS. Build/compile two PR retained-only, two PR event-only and one empty wrapper, once each, using unchanged original descriptor adapter and phase ownership. Independent tasks may parallelize after prerequisite gates.
execution_order.budget: Full4 plus later5 = maximum9 top-level cost calls. No uncharged probe, cache replay, alternative profile, replacement trajectory, retry/resume or D2/D3.
execution_order.final: Native exit and own worker reap audit, output/SHA inventory and immutable STOP. Numerical result integrity and lifecycle proof remain separate.

interpretation.same_RZ: Price reproduction is separate from semantic correspondence; same RZ is not a unitary/program proof.
interpretation.SOURCE_not_history: If B is adopted and RZ reproduced, report SOURCE-defined selected representative mechanism diagnosis, with Pauli-PR old hash FAIL retained. No exact old recursive/compiled program identity.
interpretation.quantitative_limit: Four selected representatives, no revised means, statistical confidence, population guarantee, certificate or general Pauli/DF superiority. Old PF/PR costs remain unchanged.
interpretation.unmeasured: All new RZ/CX/depth, isolation prices and interactions remain null until next approved execution. Never fill null as0.

lifecycle.old_records: Preserve old SOURCE/grant/CONSUMED/ledger/STOP exactly. No grant issued or consumed in this design.
lifecycle.new_authority: Next approval must bind the future controller SOURCE, exact QPY/descriptors/runtime, finite calls and output namespace; new grant cannot reinterpret old unused calls as transferable.
lifecycle.processes: Only own processes monitored/reaped; native completion distinct from science gates. PSI/other worktree activity alone never kills valid workers.

required_next_approval: User explicitly adopts the SOURCE criterion B with its limited claim, accepting unresolved historical preimage/name while all meaningful SOURCE edges must be established.
User explicitly authorizes finite D1 execution on four saved full QPY plus five isolation/empty builds and at most9 cost compiles, metric extraction and original signed count formulas.
Codex implements only minimal new controller connector, performs artificial checks, commits/seals SOURCE/runtime/input and issues fresh one-shot grant only within that approved next task.
resources: No arbitrary low CPU/RAM/worker caps. Parallelize independent four baselines or five later diagnostics when useful; preserve dependencies and exact finite call budget. Own directories/processes only, no shared environment/system settings/other users touched.
